note: The closest thing in this batch to the stated ICP. Business owner since eighteen, running a growing company with a team, KPIs and property interests — squarely the "already good in their life, they're successful, they own their own business" description. Capacity to pay is real: he volunteered "I could do the three thousand" and objected to the lump-sum shape rather than the amount. Health is plainly the neglected area alongside a thriving business, which is the pattern the rep himself named on the call. The framing is levelling up rather than rescue — "maximize my muscles and everything, where it'd be easier to maintain that as I age." The one criterion under strain is the exclusion: at 5'11" and 210-215 lb with the gym visited a couple of times a month he is carrying more than the ICP's picture implies, though he is emphatically not gym-averse — he runs, does push-ups daily and holds a membership. Scored as a miss on not_deconditioned to keep the exclusion honest, but this is a core-fit prospect on every criterion the ICP actually screens for.
